title: Jobs and Work

story.title: Three jobs, one family
story.text: In the Karimov family, everyone has a different job. | The father, Rustam, is an **engineer**. He works in a big **factory** and he often **works long hours**. His **salary** is good, but he is always tired. He gets on very well with his **colleagues**. | His wife, Nilufar, is a **nurse** at a **hospital**. She works **full-time** and sometimes at night. She loves her job because she helps people. | Their son, Sardor, is a **programmer**. He **works from home** three days a week and goes to the **office** two days a week. His **boss** is young and friendly. Sardor **earns money** and also studies English in the evening. | Their daughter, Madina, is still a student, but she has a **part-time** job as a **shop assistant**. She is very **good at** talking to people. Her **dream job** is to be a **doctor**, and next month she has an important **interview** at a medical university. | Grandpa Hasan is **retired** now. He was a **driver** for forty years!

answers: What job would you like in the future? Why?
**In the future I’d like to be a** programmer, **because** I love computers. **For example**, I already make simple websites for my friends.
Would you like to work from home?
Yes, I would! I don’t like traffic, and **I’m good at** working alone. But I think it’s also important to see your **colleagues** sometimes.
speech: Hi everyone! Today I want to talk about my dream job. **In the future I’d like to be a** doctor. It isn’t an easy job – doctors **work long hours** and study for many years. But **the best thing about** this **job is** that you help people every day. My aunt **works as a** nurse in a hospital, and she tells me interesting stories. **I’m good at** biology and chemistry, and I’m not afraid of hard work. In my country, doctors get a good **salary**, but for me money isn’t the most important thing. I want a job I love. Thank you!
